## Checklist

- [ ] The commit messages follow Conventional Commits, in lowercase, with `!` on a breaking change.
- [ ] Every check in CONTRIBUTING.md passes with no warnings.
- [ ] New behaviour has tests, and a new client operation is tested against a mock server.
- [ ] A change to the public API updates every caller, test and example in this pull request.
- [ ] No code, test or example names or works around a specific broker.
